description: Use this when the user asks for the lowest (or cheapest) price of an AliExpress product over a period: "lowest price in the last 30 days", "has it been cheaper?", "is this the lowest price ever?". Returns the lowest price in effect during the window, when it held, and how far today's price is from it. If our tracking began after the window opened, the answer says how many of the requested days it covers; it never claims a low beyond our own history. Every product carries pageUrl (the DipScout page with the price chart: the citation link), buyUrl (affiliate link through DipScout, disclosed in `monetization`; the price is the same with or without it), summary and citation (a self-contained sentence measured from our price history) and verdict (the short answer to "is this a good price?").

dias.description: Window in days, counted back from now.

idioma.description: Optional language for the human-readable text (title, discount.explanation, discount.warning, pageUrl): "en" (default), "de", "pt", "es" or "fr". Field names, numbers and currency (USD) are the same in every language.

produto.description: The AliExpress product URL exactly as the user pasted it (any country or language subdomain: www.aliexpress.com, pt.aliexpress.com, aliexpress.us, aliexpress.ru, m.aliexpress.com, /item/<id>.html, /i/<id>.html, ?productId=<id>), the short link the AliExpress app's Share button copies (a.aliexpress.com/_..., s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_..., even inside the shared sentence), a DipScout product URL, or the numeric product id.

name: menor_preco
title: Lowest price in N days
